{{RemovedSandboxOnly|date=29th of October 2020}} {{For|[[Slow Boss]]|[[Giant Boss]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Chained Boss |image1 = ChainedBossIcon.png |mode_appearance = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] via:
[[Golden Mode|{{Color|GoldenMode}}]] |first_wave_appearance = 22 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]1,800 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slow (1.5) |cash = {{Money|5}} on death |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{BossList|Default|Ref = Only the first '''Chained Boss''' is a [[Boss]] enemy in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode.}} }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Get ready for a HUGE boss!|Beginning of Wave 22 ([[Golden Mode|Golden]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Chained Boss''' is a slow and tanky boss, similar to the [[Slow Boss]]. It has far more health than many enemies that come before it, but is also slow, making it a shield for enemies behind it. The '''Chained Boss''' only appears in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, which is locked behind [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. The '''Chained Boss''' used to be spawned from the [[Mystery Boss]] upon its death in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode. ==Appearance== {{tabber |Current |The current version of the '''Chained Boss''' has a reflective dark green skin, and a rusted torso and legs. Chains are wrapped around both of its arms, torso and right leg. Rusted parts can be seen coming out from its back. It has a slash on its face. |Version 2 |The unused version of the '''Chained Boss''' had a reflective dark green skin, and a rusted torso and legs. Chains were wrapped around both of its arms, torso and right leg. Rusted parts could be seen coming out from its back. It had glowing yellow eyes and a drooling zombie face. It walked slightly hunchbacked and had a twisted left leg. |Version 1 |The '''Chained Boss''' was slightly taller than the [[Slow Boss]], and walked with its head slightly tilted forwards. It had light green skin, a green pebble torso and grey pebble legs. Its eyes were also glowing yellow and it had a drooling zombie face. A chain was wrapped around its torso. It also had rusty parts coming out of where its heart would be, front and back. Its head also appeared to have a tumor on the right side. }} ==Strategy== *High DPS towers such as the [[Minigunner]] or [[Turret]] can easily defeat the '''Chained Boss'''. **The [[Ranger]] also works well against this enemy. **If needed, the [[Commander]] can decrease the firerate of these towers. *Later on during the game, '''Chained Bosses''' spawn in hordes quite close to each other. **For this reason, splash damage towers such as the [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]] are quite effective against it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Other Variants}} ChainedBoss.png|Second version, unused (added 29 October 2020) Chained.png|First version (10 July 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseChainedBoss.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Trailer|'''Chained Boss''' in the game trailer. Tower Defense Simulator Frost Invasion Trailer|'''Chained Boss''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ChainedBossIconIG.png|'''Chained Boss''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Chained Boss''' was not considered a boss before being renamed in the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]] as it was simply called the ''Chained''. *For a brief period of time, the '''Chained Boss''' actually appeared naturally in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode on a single wave. However, this was later changed to [[Giant Boss]]es. **The [[Uber Mystery]] also had a chance to summon in the '''Chained Boss''' in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''10 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.3|BETA v1.3.0]] **'''Chained''' added. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **Renamed from '''Chained''' to '''Chained Boss'''. **Basic Freeze Immunity replaced with [[Freeze Immunity]]. **First wave appearance changed from wave 52 to wave 22 on Hard mode (later Golden mode) and wave 28 on Insane mode (later Fallen mode). *'''25 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.3|Release v1.3.0]] **'''Chained Boss''' no longer naturally appears in [[Fallen Mode|Insane]] mode. *'''14 February 2020''' - [[Release v1.7|Release v1.7.1]] **[[Partial Electric Immunity]] added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Chained Boss''' removed. **'''NOTE''': While the '''Chained Boss''' was removed in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], multiple changes were made to it, though they could never be seen in-game due to its removal. These are: ***Appearance changed. ***Defense of 10 added. ***Health decreased from 2,500 to 1,800. ***[[Freeze Immunity]] and [[Partial Electric Immunity]] removed. ***{{Bug}} Rust parts at the front of its torso fall into the void. *'''17 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0|v1.46.4]] **'''Chained Boss''' now appears in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, if activated through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ***Because of changes made with updates, its appearance has been updated. *'''17 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0|v1.46.5]] **'''Chained Boss''' no longer appears in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, as it has been removed. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0|v1.53.3a]] **'''Chained Boss''' now appears in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, if activated through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. }} ==Notes== {{Golden|[[Golden]]|Wave 20|Chained Boss|Wave 22|[[Dark Necromancer]]|Wave 23}} {{Hard|[[Controlled]]|Wave 51|Chained|Wave 52|[[Witch Doctor]]|Wave 54}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
